about: The material library, pinned: python/fairbeam/materials.py (LIBRARY) and src/designer/materials.ts (MATERIAL_LIBRARY) must both equal this list (python/tests/test_materials.py, scripts/check-designer.mjs). Change all three together.

library.name: copper
library.label: PEC (copper)
library.note: Perfect electric conductor (openEMS metal). Copper's finite conductivity (5.8e7 S/m) and surface roughness are not modeled; the conductor loss of printed antennas is small.

library.name: FR4
library.label: FR4
library.note: Generic glass-epoxy laminate. εr 4.2–4.7 and tan δ 0.015–0.025 vary with the resin content, the supplier and the frequency: use your laminate's datasheet.

library.name: RO4003C
library.label: Rogers RO4003C
library.note: Rogers RO4003C datasheet: process εr 3.38 ± 0.05 and tan δ 0.0027 at 10 GHz, 23 °C (Rogers recommends the design εr 3.55 for circuit design).

library.name: RO4350B
library.label: Rogers RO4350B
library.note: Rogers RO4350B datasheet: process εr 3.48 ± 0.05 and tan δ 0.0037 at 10 GHz, 23 °C (design εr 3.66).

library.name: RT5880
library.label: Rogers RT/duroid 5880
library.note: Rogers RT/duroid 5880 datasheet: εr 2.20 ± 0.02 and tan δ 0.0009 at 10 GHz.

library.name: TLY-5
library.label: Taconic TLY-5
library.note: Taconic (AGC) TLY-5 datasheet: εr 2.20 ± 0.02 and tan δ 0.0009 at 10 GHz.

library.name: alumina
library.label: Alumina 99.5 %
library.note: Typical of 99.5 % alumina thin-film substrates (εr 9.7–9.9, tan δ about 0.0001 at microwave frequencies); check the supplier's value.

library.name: PTFE
library.label: PTFE (Teflon)
library.note: Bulk PTFE, typical: εr 2.0–2.1, tan δ 0.0001–0.0003 from 1 to 10 GHz.

library.name: air
library.label: Air / vacuum
library.note: Free space. The background is vacuum already; use it with a higher priority to cut an air gap or a hole out of another dielectric.
